findings: learner.overview: “辵, the path element written 辶 at the side” is inaccurate for 进 as written; 辶 is present in traditional 進, while 进 shows 辶 as its left component and 井 in place of 隹. Clarify the relationship without implying 辶 is absent from the current graph.

components[1]: The component is scoped to 进, but “origin_form”: “隹” and “origin_relation”: “uncertain” misclassify the change. The cited evidence identifies standardized 进〔進〕 as a whole-character simplified mapping and describes 井 as taking the place of 隹 in that mapping. Use “origin_form”: “進” and “origin_relation”: “simplified_form”; retain the internal replacement description in the text and replacement edge.
